scope: Original M1 low-cost alternative candidate only; no acceptance of limited-coverage RPN/ROI primary, full-Val execution, training, M9 or feedback
route: Existing frozen MASA-SAM checkpoint -> SAM fixed positive point grid -> no-crop default AMG masks -> anonymous valid mask boxes -> unchanged causal MASA tracker
default_caveat: Upstream says these defaults were chosen for ViT-H; existing model is ViT-B. No threshold search or stronger-model download is authorized by this smoke.
geometry: Official PIL ResizeLongestSide1024; one normalization/padding. Shared final block -> SAM neck and multi-level -> MASA adapter. Original xyxy max pixel coordinate convention preserved.
owned_wrapper_differences: Box-only: no RLE/mask archive; crop_n_layers=0 makes crop-edge filter inert
Count/drop only empty or zero-area mask boxes before physical association; no box repair or GT-driven filter
Native raw predicted IoU only filters/ranks masks; tracker score is bounded mask stability, not foreground probability, with no sigmoid/clipping/calibration
provenance: Same published generic-image route and disclosed private-stage ledger gap as existing MASA candidate. Tensor presence is not independent proof of exact pretrained SAM identity.
selection: Exactly first four chronological image paths from the already-pinned Train pilot; drop all GT fields before worker. Known long-track selection bias, engineering-only, not coverage estimation.
forward_plan: Two chronological four-image replays; invert only future ordinals2,3 in replay2; prefix ordinals0,1 must reproduce exact detection/track hashes
parent_source_config_guard: Exact remotely verified preregistration commit for this config, runner, owned wrapper and source manifest; existing native source/checkpoint identities separately verified
worker_barrier: No socket/child/GT annotation/splits/GT pilot selection/Val/Test frames. Worker sees only sanitized Train image paths.
pass_requires: Finite non-degenerate anonymous proposals and tracks; original replay must have nonzero proposals and tracks
Exact prefix0,1 equality with genuinely changed future pixels
not_established_by_pass: Formal cache or semantic learning authority
M9, A+B, M11 or completed goal
publish: Small aggregate mask/track counts, hashes, timing, resources and explicit quality contract; private image paths and pixels stay local
